headline: Court lets Pentagon blacklist Anthropic over Claude
summary: A divided appeals court panel ruled that the Pentagon can designate Anthropic a supply-chain risk, siding with the Trump administration over Anthropic's argument that its rights were violated. The judges reasoned that overly constrained AI models could cause military operations to fail. One report attributes the designation specifically to Anthropic refusing to enable certain Claude features.
